claude.desc: Install forwarder hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json so every Claude Code session reports here. Fail-open: with Cognia closed they exit instantly.
claude.label: Claude Code hooks

codex.desc: Register the forwarder in ~/.codex/hooks.json. Merged into the file, so hooks other tools registered keep working; uninstall removes only ours.
codex.label: Codex hooks
codex.trustHint: Codex only runs hooks you have trusted, and it keys that trust to the hook's exact command — approve the prompt in the Codex TUI after installing. A modified entry loses its trust and will not fire until reinstalled.

description: Watch and control coding agents launched anywhere on this machine (terminals, editors) — not just ones started by Cognia.

island.desc: Dynamic-Island-style always-on-top strip showing live agent sessions near the notch.

detailVisibility.desc: How much of a task's detail the island may receive. Prompts, paths, commands, plans and full error text never travel with the regular list.
detailVisibility.label: Detail in the island

diagnostics.copied: Island diagnostics copied to the clipboard.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Could not write to the clipboard.
diagnostics.desc: Copy every input the island uses to place itself. Sample it once on a normal Space, once with an app full-screen, and once on an external display.
diagnostics.label: Placement diagnostics
diagnostics.unavailable: Island diagnostics are only available in the desktop app.

hideOnFullscreen.desc: Withdraw the island while a full-screen app owns its display, leaving the top strip to that app. A session that needs you still brings it back. macOS only.
hideOnFullscreen.label: Hide under full-screen apps

island.label: Island overlay

monitor.desc: Local event ingress for external agent hooks. Runs on the companion server, loopback only.
monitor.label: Fleet monitoring

opencode.desc: Install a plugin into ~/.config/opencode/plugin. Observe sessions and approve/deny permissions from the island.
opencode.label: OpenCode plugin

outbox.corrupt: The durable command queue is corrupt; controls are disabled.
outbox.unavailable: The durable command queue is unavailable; controls are disabled.

title: Agent fleet monitor

workers.bindingHint: Remote AgentTeam placement reuses these authenticated Fleet hosts and Task Workspace bindings.
workers.copyFailed: Could not copy the enrollment command.
workers.description: Enroll least-privilege CLI workers and inspect their placement readiness.
workers.dispatchUnavailable: This host cannot dispatch to workers right now. They stay connected, but no run will be sent to them until the host's execution brain is available.
workers.notConnected: Connect Companion before enrolling a worker.
workers.remoteDispatchDescription: Allow new AgentTeam teammates to use eligible remote workers. Turn this off to stop new remote dispatch immediately; active remote sessions can still settle safely.
workers.title: Execution workers
